title: skills: `skills/objectstack-i18n` does not teach `i18n.sourceLocale` (the inline text's language, apart from the users' `defaultLocale`)
body:
domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSbLCxEmyHf9upz3pz

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #33357 (#33232). Contract review record 6882834204 (③) found it owed and not filed.
Business reason: an AI agent that authors an app in English for Chinese users learns from the published skill that `defaultLocale` and `--default-locale` are the only locale knobs. So it sets `defaultLocale: 'en'` and loses the users' default, or it gets 446 false "missing en" findings.
Reader who acts: `domain:skills`, `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`.

## 维护者速读

i18n 技能文档还没有 `sourceLocale` 这一行，AI 照着写会把"用户默认语言"和"元数据原文语言"混为一谈。等 #33232（PR #33357）合并后，在键表里加一行，并更新 `--default-locale` 的说明。

## Work (after PR #33357 merges)

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `i18n` key table (near line 45): add a `sourceLocale` row. It is the language the inline `label:` text is written in, defaulting to `defaultLocale`, and it is read by `os lint`, `os i18n check` and `os i18n extract`.
- The `--default-locale` mention (near line 419): it now overrides the source locale (`i18n.sourceLocale`, else `i18n.defaultLocale`, else `en`).
- State the serving-layer caveat as PR #33357 publishes it (declare `fallbackLocale` until the companion serving card lands).

Blocked-by: #33232

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue sourceLocale` → only #33232. Related: #33232, PR #33357.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
